sourceTitle: 80 PLUS Verification and Testing Report, ID 7300.2
scope: Reported steady-load terminal measurements from a certification test, not unit-to-unit statistics, a transient minimum, or a guaranteed board-input voltage.

cases.note: This PSU test point has less than 5.5 A total 12 V load; do not combine it with the full 5.5 A board-drop case.
This PSU test point has less than 5.5 A total 12 V load; do not combine it with the full 5.5 A board-drop case.

limitations: The measured test loads include multiple PSU rails and are not GPU-only loads.
The certificate reports cumulative 12 V output; individual 24-pin cable/contact voltages are not established.
Subtracting board DC loss assumes the reported terminal voltage reaches the board feed pads. Extra wiring/contact/ground loss and hot MOSFET increase remain excluded.
No probability of reaching 11.20 V can be inferred from these selected steady-state load measurements.
No model-specific dynamic voltage excursion data were found in this research.
